mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS declines alone without the other, or when 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of joint decline events.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below its 6-month average during late-cycle economic regimes signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 6-month average in late-cycle regimes does not predict negative 60-day returns, with SPX returns positive in more than 55% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy that raises real rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS > 150,000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,700,000 units annually, it indicates a robust housing market that stimulates consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 1700.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in CPI inflation and the federal funds rate signal a tightening monetary policy cycle that raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when either CPIAUCSL or FEDFUNDS increases alone without the other, or when 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of joint increase events.
